blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task on character-level hallucination span detection in image-conditioned vision-language model (VLM) responses, evaluated across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. The detector is built on a frozen Gemma-4-12B-it backbone with trainable LoRA adapters (approximately 10.7M parameters). Because the backbone is a causal decoder, hidden states read from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens; we therefore repeat the candidate answer within one prompt and extract features from its second occurrence, giving every position approximate bidirectional context in a single non-autoregressive pass. A character-level locator combines intermediate hidden states to predict hallucination probabilities, BIO boundaries, and a response-level abstention score, while separate language-specific classifiers assign one of five hallucination types to each predicted span. On the closed test set, our system reaches a macro-averaged character IoU of 0.4404, more than doubling the official baseline (0.1854), and ranks 5th-6th on IoU across the four languages. On the English tuning split, controlled ablations attribute a gain to the repeated answer that is comparable to that of LoRA adaptation (its held-out gain is smaller and concentrated on hallucinated answers), and they show that the detector relies on the image-answer pairing: shuffling images across examples drives IoU down to the level of the predict-nothing floor or below it in every language. In deployments where the same Gemma-4-12B-it model also generates answers, its base weights can be reused, making the approach practical for local question-answering systems that cannot run a separate verifier.
blocks.zh: 我们提出2026年SHROOM-visions的系统, 共同的任务是在图像条件化的视觉语言模型(VLM)反应中, 探测器以冷冻的Gemma-4-12B-it骨干为主干线,并配有可受训练的LORA适配器(约10.7M参数). 因为骨干是因果解码器,所以从一个答案的单份读取的隐藏状态不能处理后续的符号;因此,我们在一个即时重复候选人的答案,并从第二次出现时取出特征,使每个位置在一次非自发回回转中都有大致的双向上下文. 一个字符级定位器结合中间隐藏状态来预测幻觉概率,BIO边界,以及一个响应级的弃权分数,而单独的语言特异分类器则为每个被预测的跨度分配出五个幻觉类型中的一个. 在封闭测试集上,我们的系统达到了一个宏平均字符IoU为0.4404,比官方基准(0.1854)翻了一番以上,在IoU上排名第5-6,跨越了四种语言. 在英语调音分解上,受控调音符将一个增益归属于与LORA调音符相仿的重复回答(其被持有的增益更小并集中在幻觉解答上),它们表明探测器依赖于图像解答对接:将图像横跨实例将IoU推向了预测-无底或下方的每一种语言. 在同样Gemma-4-12B-it模型也生成答案的部署中,其基重可以被再用,使无法运行单独验证器的局部问答系统的方法切实可行.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain a central
reliability challenge for multimodal systems ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . The SHROOM shared-task series
introduced model-aware and model-agnostic hallucination detection ( Mickus et al., 2024 ) and was later extended to multilingual
character-level span detection in Mu-SHROOM ( Vázquez et al., 2025 ) .

视觉语言模型中的幻觉仍然是中心
对多式联运系统的可靠性挑战(Liu等人,2024年) SHROOM 共享任务系列
引入了模型意识和模型不可知幻觉检测(Mickus等人,2024年),后来推广到多语种.
Mu-SHROOM(巴斯克斯等人,2025年)的字符跨度检测。

blocks.en:
This paper describes our system for the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task ( Vázquez et al., 2026 ) , built around the multilingual SHEEP
benchmark ( Mickus et al., 2026 ) . The task requires identifying
hallucinated character spans in VLM-generated answers.
Figure 1 gives an overview of our pipeline.

blocks.en: Figure 1: High-level overview of our hallucination detection pipeline, showing the information flow from multimodal input to final labeled spans.
blocks.zh: 图1:关于我们幻觉探测管道的高级别概览,显示从多式联运输入到最后标注跨度的信息流。

blocks.en:
Our response-repetition scheme adapts echo-style contextualization, previously explored for sentence embeddings and sequence labeling, to multimodal character-level hallucination localization ( Springer et al., 2025 ; Kukić et al., 2026 ) . Because our backbone, Gemma-4-12B-it, is a causal decoder, hidden states extracted from a single copy of an answer cannot attend to subsequent tokens. To bypass this, our prompt includes the candidate answer twice. The first copy serves as context, while features are extracted from the tokens of the second (“review”) copy. This allows every position to attend to the image, the question, and the entire first copy (Figure 2 ), approximating bidirectional context without modifying the causal attention mask. After response generation, localization requires one non-autoregressive LoRA-enabled backbone pass over the repeated-response prompt. Span typing
is performed in a second pass through the same base checkpoint with the
LoRA adapters disabled. The implementation, evaluation scripts, and the
ablation dumps behind Section 6.1 are publicly
available. 1 1 1 https://github.com/sckwokyboom/Vision-Hallucination-Detector

blocks.en: 2 Task Setup
blocks.zh: 2 任务设置

blocks.en:
Each datapoint in SHROOM-visions 2026 consists of an image, a textual
prompt (e.g. a visual question), a model-generated answer, and a
character-level annotation: for every character of the answer, the
gold standard records whether it belongs to a hallucinated span and,
if so, which of five hallucination types the span belongs to. Systems
must therefore output, per character, a hallucination probability
together with a per-span type label. Evaluation is performed
separately on four languages: English, French, Italian, and Chinese.
To illustrate, an answer such as “ There are five apples and a
banana ” to an image showing exactly three apples may yield the
spans “ five ” (Miscounting) and “ a banana ”
(Invention).
blocks.zh:
SHROOM-visions 2026中的每个数据点都包含一个图像,一个文本

字符级别注释: 对于答案的每个字符,

因此,每个字符必须输出幻觉概率
与每平方块类型标签一起。 进行了评价
分别讲四种语言:英语、法语、意大利语和中文。
举例来说,一个答案是:“有五个苹果,一个苹果,一个苹果。
香蕉”的图像显示,
“五”和“香蕉”
(发明).

blocks.en: 3 Data and Splits
blocks.zh: 3 数据与分割

blocks.en:
Our system relies exclusively on the official SHROOM-visions 2026
training data ( Mickus et al., 2026 ) , without external or synthetic
augmentation.
blocks.zh:
我们的系统完全依靠2026年SHROOM官方视觉
培训数据(Mickus等人,2026年),无外部或合成数据
增ation.

blocks.en: To ensure rigorous evaluation, we implemented a deterministic split rule based on the MD5 hash of the image name: int(md5("13:" + image_name)[:8], 16) / 2^32 < 0.1 . This ensures all answers about a single image land on the same side of the split. For English, the development side was further divided into tune-202 (for decision making) and held-out-157 (evaluated exactly once). To control cross-language leakage during multilingual training, we applied a hard filter to drop any item sharing an image with a protocol evaluation item, resulting in 12,874 training items.
blocks.zh: 为了确保严格的评价,我们根据图像名称的MD5散列执行了一个确定性的分割规则:int(md5("13:"+图像_名称)[:8],16)/2^32 < 0.1. 这保证了所有关于分裂的同一侧的单一图像土地的答案. 对英语来说,开发方面被进一步分为谐音-202(用于决策)和hold-out-157(精确评价一次). 为了控制多语种培训过程中的跨语言渗漏,我们采用了硬滤波器将任何与协议评价项目共享的图像项目丢弃,最终产生了12,874个培训项目.

blocks.en: 4 System Architecture
blocks.zh: 4 系统架构

blocks.en: 4.1 Backbone and LoRA
blocks.zh: 4.1 后骨和LORA

blocks.en:
We use google/gemma-4-12b-it ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) as our frozen backbone in bfloat16 precision. Images are resized to a maximum side of
768 pixels. We apply Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout 0.05 to the q q , k k , v v , and o o attention projections of layers 24 through 47. This range encompasses all four layers used for feature tapping, introducing approximately 10.7M trainable parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们使用google/gemma-4-12b-it(Gemma Team,2026)作为我们冰冻的骨干在bfloat16精度. 图像大小调整到最大边
768像素图. 我们把低Rank适应(LORA)(Hu等人,2022年)分为16级,α = 32\alpha = 32级,对q q ,k k , v , 和 o 的注意力预测分为24至47级. 这个范围包括用于地物挖掘的所有四个层,引入了大约10.7M可训练参数。

blocks.en: 4.2 Locator Decoder
blocks.zh: 4.2 定位器解码器

blocks.en: Figure 3: Detailed architecture of the Locator Decoder. The system mixes hidden states from four backbone layers, converts tokens to characters with position embeddings, and refines them via Conv1d and BiGRU stages before outputting four specialized logits.
blocks.zh: 图3:定位解码器的详细架构. 系统将隐藏状态从四个主干层混合,将符号转换为带有位置嵌入的字符,并在输出四个专业对数之前通过Conv1d和BiGRU阶段对其进行精炼.

blocks.en: Features 𝐇 ∈ ℝ T × 4 × 3840 \mathbf{H}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times 4\times 3840} are extracted from layers l ∈ { 24 , 32 , 40 , 47 } l\in\{24,32,40,47\} (Figure 3 ). A LayerMix mechanism computes a softmax-normalized weighted sum of these layers, followed by a linear projection to 768 dimensions. We use a token-to-character scatter operation: each character receives its covering token’s vector concatenated with a 32-dimensional embedding of the character’s position within the token.

The character refiner consists of two Conv1d layers with GELU
activations ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2016 ) , followed by a bidirectional GRU ( Cho et al., 2014 ; Schuster and Paliwal, 1997 ) added
residually. Four heads operate on these refined states: z p z_{p} (per-character logit), z q z_{q} (auxiliary localization), z bio z_{\mathrm{bio}} (O/B/I tags ( Ramshaw and Marcus, 1995 ) ), and z g z_{g} (answer-level gate).

blocks.en: 4.3 Span-Type Classifier
blocks.zh: 4.3 平面分类器

blocks.en:
A standalone classifier assigns one of five hallucination types to the predicted spans: Invention (entities or content absent from the image), Mischaracterization (incorrect description of visible content), OCR Problem (misreading of text in the image), Miscounting (wrong quantity of visible items), and Other . It is trained per track on gold spans. The input features include the layer-averaged frozen hidden state of the span’s tokens and three scalar length/position features. The classifier architecture is a simple multi-layer perceptron:
LayerNorm ( Ba et al., 2016 ) , followed by a linear layer, GELU
activation ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2016 ) , dropout, and an output linear
layer.
blocks.zh:
一个独立的分类器将五个幻觉类型中的一个指定为预测的跨度:发明(图像中缺失的实体或内容),错定性(可见内容描述不正确),OCR问题(图像中文本的误读),错计(可见项目数量错误),以及其他. 每个赛道都接受过金色横跨的培训。 输入的特性包括层平均冷冻的间隙符号隐藏状态和三个斜拉长度/位置特性。 分类器架构是一个简单的多层透视:
图层Norm(Ba等人,2016年),然后是线性层GELU.
启动(Hendrycks和Gimpel,2016年),退出,输出线性
层。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en:
The task ranks systems separately per language on three character-level
metrics ( Vázquez et al., 2026 ) : IoU , the
intersection-over-union between the predicted and gold sets of
hallucinated characters (span identification); Cor , the
correlation between the predicted per-character hallucination
probability and the empirical multi-annotator gold probability
(confidence calibration); and Cor+Lbl , the label-conditioned
variant of Cor in which a character contributes only when its
predicted hallucination type matches the gold type.

Classifier relabeling provided an additional improvement over our constant-label variant , a reference that assigns the single
most frequent hallucination type to every predicted span. Replacing
this fixed label with the learned span-type classifier
(Sec. 4.3 ) increased the macro-average Cor+Lbl score
from 0.2476 to 0.3361 ( + 0.0885 +0.0885 ), whereas the macro-average Cor score
changed only from 0.4631 to 0.4669 ( + 0.0038 +0.0038 ). This confirms that the
classifier primarily improved hallucination-type assignment, as
intended.

Table 2 isolates the main design choices. LoRA
adaptation was the largest single contributor (+0.039 IoU), direct
visual-token cross-attention did not help, and joint multilingual
training improved Chinese by +0.032, which mattered because the Chinese
training split contains the fewest hallucinated answers. The single-copy control tests the paper’s central claim directly:
the same detector (LoRA, LayerMix, Conv1d + BiGRU refiner, identical
loss, schedule and seed) is trained on a prompt that contains the answer
once, so every feature is strictly causal. Under the trainer decode of
Table 2 (before post-processing) it loses 0.029 IoU on
tune-202 (0.415 vs. 0.386) and 0.009 on held-out-157 (0.385 vs. 0.376), and 0.032 / 0.010 Cor; with the submission post-processing the
IoU gaps are 0.035 and 0.006. The loss is concentrated where the
mechanism should matter: on hallucinated answers, span IoU drops from
0.326 to 0.283 (tune-202) and from 0.294 to 0.235 (held-out-157). The
character-level BiGRU therefore does not substitute for answer-level
context inside the backbone. With one seed, the held-out difference in overall IoU is within the run-to-run variation we measured for
the frozen baseline; the localisation gain on hallucinated answers is
consistent across both splits.

blocks.en:
Table 3 evaluates the submitted checkpoint of every track
with the correct image, with images shuffled across examples (a seeded
derangement over the split’s unique images, so no answer keeps its own
image), and with no image, at the submitted thresholds. A mismatched
image is not ignored but actively misleading: the detector flags almost
every answer (only 2–14% of clean answers stay empty; 40% for
Italian), and IoU falls by 0.12–0.27, to within 0.01 of the
predict-nothing floor or below it in every track. Removing the image costs 0.05–0.13 IoU and
0.05–0.12 Cor: the model then abstains more and localises worse on
hallucinated answers. Re-tuning the thresholds for the degraded
conditions recovers only part of the loss (English tune-202: 0.325
without the image vs. 0.422 with it). All paired image-cluster
bootstrap CIs of these differences exclude zero
(Appendix B ). The predictions are thus driven by the
image–answer pairing; the no-image scores above the floor show that
answer-internal cues carry some signal, but not the bulk of it.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented an effective, non-generative character-level hallucination detection pipeline. By utilizing a dual-prompting strategy to secure bidirectional context and decoupling boundary detection from span classification, our system achieved robust performance across all four languages in the SHROOM-visions 2026 shared task. On the English tuning split, the repeated answer contributes a gain comparable to that of LoRA adaptation, with a smaller held-out gain that is concentrated on hallucinated answers; the detector’s predictions depend on the image–answer pairing rather than on textual regularities alone.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个有效,非遗传性 字符级幻觉检测管道。 通过采用双时速战略,确保双向环境,使边界探测与跨度分类脱钩,我们的系统在2026年SHROOM-visions共同任务中在所有四种语言中都取得了强劲的业绩。 在英语调音拆分上,重复的答案贡献了一个与LORA适应相类似的收益,一个较小的搁置收益集中在幻觉解答上;探测器的预测依赖于图像-解答配对,而不是仅仅依赖于文字规律.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our approach and experimental setup have several limitations: • Single Seed: Experiments, including the ablations of Section 6.1 , use a single random seed (13). Run-to-run variation was estimated only for the frozen baseline ( ± 0.0060 \pm 0.0060 IoU), so differences of that size—such as the held-out-157 gap between the echo and single-copy prompts—should not be over-interpreted. • Data Leakage in Decision Making: The tune-202 split was reused for multiple threshold sweeps and post-processing decisions. While mitigated in English via the held-out-157 split, the French, Italian, and Chinese tracks lacked untouched held-out data. Section 6.1 bounds the effect: with the English operating point fixed in advance, those tracks lose between 0.002 and 0.032 IoU. • Classifier Distribution Shift: The span-type classifier was trained on gold spans but deployed on predicted (imperfect) spans. Validation splits for this classifier were span-random rather than image-disjoint. • Language-Specific Tuning: The minimum-span-length rule (3 characters) was tuned on English and applied uniformly. For Chinese, where a single character can encompass a severe factual hallucination, this costs 0.015 development IoU (Table 4 ); the submitted Chinese results therefore understate what a script-aware rule would achieve. • Image Dependence: The image-shuffle and no-image controls are evaluation-time interventions on models trained with the correct image. A detector trained without images could exploit textual regularities more effectively than our no-image numbers suggest; we did not train such a model.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法和实验设置有几个局限性: • 单一种子:实验,包括第6.1节的堆积,使用单一随机种子(13). 仅对冻结基线(± 0.0060\pm 0.0060 IoU)的运行变化进行了估计,因此,不应过度解释这种大小的差异——例如回声和单拷贝提示之间的悬空157。 • 支助 决策中的数据泄露: 调 -202 拆分被重新用于多个阈值扫描和处理后的决定. 法国、意大利和中国的音轨虽然通过被搁置的157分法在英语中有所缓解,但缺少未被搁置的数据。 第6.1节限定了效果:在英语操作点事先固定后,这些轨道在0.002至0.032 IoU之间丢失。 跨度类型分类员接受了黄金跨度的培训,但部署在预测(不完美)跨度。 此分类器的校验拆分是跨度随机的, 而不是图像分离的 。 • 具体语言 调音 : 最小宽规则(3个字符)以英文为调制,并统一适用。 对于中文来说,如果一个单一的字符可以包含一个严重的事实上的幻觉,这需要0.015开发IoU(表4);因此提交的中文结果低估了剧本意识规则将实现的目标。 • 支助 图像依赖性 : 图像洗涤和无图像控制是对经过正确图像培训的模型的评价时间干预。 一个没有图像的探测器可以比我们的无图像数字显示的更有效利用文字规律;我们没有训练这种模型。

blocks.en: Single Seed: Experiments, including the ablations of Section 6.1 , use a single random seed (13). Run-to-run variation was estimated only for the frozen baseline ( ± 0.0060 \pm 0.0060 IoU), so differences of that size—such as the held-out-157 gap between the echo and single-copy prompts—should not be over-interpreted.
blocks.zh: 单种种子:实验,包括第6.1节的擦伤,使用单随机种子(13). 仅对冻结基线(± 0.0060\pm 0.0060 IoU)的运行变化进行了估计,因此,不应过度解释这种大小的差异——例如回声和单拷贝提示之间的悬空157。

blocks.en: Data Leakage in Decision Making: The tune-202 split was reused for multiple threshold sweeps and post-processing decisions. While mitigated in English via the held-out-157 split, the French, Italian, and Chinese tracks lacked untouched held-out data. Section 6.1 bounds the effect: with the English operating point fixed in advance, those tracks lose between 0.002 and 0.032 IoU.
blocks.zh: 决策中的数据泄露: 调 -202 拆分被重新用于多个阈值扫描和处理后的决定. 法国、意大利和中国的音轨虽然通过被搁置的157分法在英语中有所缓解,但缺少未被搁置的数据。 第6.1节限定了效果:在英语操作点事先固定后,这些轨道损失在0.002至0.032 IoU之间.

blocks.en: Classifier Distribution Shift: The span-type classifier was trained on gold spans but deployed on predicted (imperfect) spans. Validation splits for this classifier were span-random rather than image-disjoint.
blocks.zh: 分类分配器 移动 : 跨度类型分类员接受了黄金跨度的培训,但部署在预测(不完美)跨度。 此分类器的校验拆分是跨度随机的, 而不是图像分离的 。

blocks.en: Language-Specific Tuning: The minimum-span-length rule (3 characters) was tuned on English and applied uniformly. For Chinese, where a single character can encompass a severe factual hallucination, this costs 0.015 development IoU (Table 4 ); the submitted Chinese results therefore understate what a script-aware rule would achieve.
blocks.zh: 语言特异性图宁: 最小宽规则(3个字符)以英文为调制,并统一适用。 对于中文来说,如果一个单一的字符可以包含一个严重的事实上的幻觉,这需要0.015开发IoU(表4);因此提交的中文结果低估了剧本意识规则将实现的目标。

blocks.en: Image Dependence: The image-shuffle and no-image controls are evaluation-time interventions on models trained with the correct image. A detector trained without images could exploit textual regularities more effectively than our no-image numbers suggest; we did not train such a model.
